end.summary:
Observed and described bird beaks, duck feet, and leaf/feature vocabulary.
Linked short, cone-shaped beaks with seeds and pointed beaks with catching fish or insects.
Linked webbed feet with swimming.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; no recorded misconceptions.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing bird features and connecting beak and foot shapes to feeding and movement, using examples such as ducks and kingfishers. They explained that short, cone-shaped beaks can eat seeds, pointed beaks can catch fish, and webbed feet help with swimming. At home, ask them to observe one bird or plant and name two features and what each feature helps it do.
